scope: Employer-only initial research in nine municipalities outside Groningen city; not exhaustive.
size_policy: Employer/group/site scopes are separate. Unknown stays unknown. Source dates and qualifications are explicit; municipality presence never determines a job workplace.

employers.name: Delamine

size.employees_text: Employer profile reports 70 staff across sales, marketing, logistics and production; Delfzijl is the production site, Amersfoort the head office.

notes: Independent Nouryon/Tosoh joint venture; 70 is employer-wide, not the Farmsum plant headcount. Career channel requires discovery from official site.

employers.name: Royal Wagenborg

size.employees_text: Official group profile describes approximately 3,000 professionals worldwide and a head office in Delfzijl.

notes: Existing wagenborg-passagiersdiensten belongs to the same group. Keep group identity shared; do not count a second distinct group. Official linked recruiting platform shares Royal Wagenborg feed.

employers.name: Royal Niestern Sander

size.employees_text: Employer facts list 160 skilled employees across its yards; Farmsum, Delfzijl and Eemshaven are named operating locations.

notes: Distinct shipyard employer within Royal Wagenborg; recruitment links to shared group platform.

size.employees_text: 2025 annual report: 108 employees (104.5 FTE), compared with 104 in 2024.

employers.name: Heiploeg

size.employees_text: Official local hiring page describes more than 400 employees in production; Zoutkamp is the principal site. This excludes the separate worldwide figure of approximately 2,500.

notes: Local employee statement is separate from temporary holiday recruitment; do not add holiday workers to the 400.

employers.name: De Zijlen

size.employees_text: 2024 annual report distinguishes 1,566 employees (1,030 FTE), 423 volunteers and 97 interns.

notes: Headcount covers all locations; not assigned to Tolbert alone. A newer 2025 report is published and can replace this dated headcount after verification.

employers.name: Stichting Vredewold

size.employees_text: Official organisation page identifies more than 300 paid employees and approximately 100 volunteers separately.

notes: 2024 annual report provides 320 employees and 158.5 FTE; webpage uses the conservative 300+ wording.

employers.name: Koninklijke Oosterhof Holman

size.employees_text: Employer-owned public profile describes around 400 employees across its company locations; Grijpskerk hosts the headquarters.

notes: Reuse existing employer, add Grijpskerk workplace; existing Fryslân footprint must remain. Company-owned LinkedIn post is size source; trade association article independently corroborates scale.

employers.name: Essity

size.employees_text: FNV primary workforce report dated March 2026 identifies approximately 500 employees at Hoogezand. Employer fact sheet separately documented 455 in 2018.

notes: Existing registry entry is Essity Italy: reuse group after reviewing employer identity, add Dutch workplace/country and preserve Italian source. Current local count comes from union primary source, not the employer; dated employer fact sheet corroborates threshold only.

employers.name: Royal Bodewes

size.employees_text: Official careers counter specifies 100+ workers; underlying public HTML has Workers next to data-to-value=100.

notes: Counter initial text is 0 before animation. The 100 target was verified in public HTML, not inferred from the displayed initial 0. Address: Werfkade 22, 9601 LG Hoogezand.

employers.name: Royal Avebe

size.employees_text: 2023/2024 audited statement reports an average 1,285 employees, including 285 outside the Netherlands.

notes: Headcount is group-wide and historical. Newer 2024/2025 report is available; no local headcounts are inferred. Exclude Gasselternijveen and Valthermond from Groningen province because they are in Drenthe.

employers.name: Ommelander Ziekenhuis Groningen

size.employees_text: Official organisation profile describes 1,500 colleagues working from the hospital in Scheemda.

notes: Older UMCG ownership references should be checked against current group identity before merging group totals; a cooperation statement alone is insufficient.

employers.name: Afeer

size.employees_text: 2024 annual report says Afeer organises work for more than 750 employees with a disability, the large majority directly employed by Afeer. This establishes the 50+ threshold; 750 is not represented as an exact payroll total.

notes: 50 is a conservative qualification floor, not observed total headcount. Separate trajectories/placements with other employers from direct payroll. The current employer is Afeer, formerly Synergon.

employers.name: Solidus

size.employees_text: Official careers profile describes more than 1,500 people across European mills, converting plants and sales offices.

notes: 2025 brochure named both Oude Pekela and Bad Nieuweschans mills; older brochure headcount 1,400 is superseded by live careers page.

employers.name: Treant

size.employees_text: Official employer vacancy describes approximately 6,000 employees, separately from approximately 270 medical specialists.

notes: Refaja hospital in Stadskanaal is verified by the official location directions. Group staff also work in Drenthe. Recruiting URL is the employer careers site listed by its ZorgpleinNoord organisation profile.

employers.name: Wedeka

size.employees_text: 2025 annual report explicitly identifies 1,187 people with a distance to the labour market directly employed at 31 December 2025; 500 trajectory participants are reported separately.

notes: Do not use total people in trajectories as employee headcount. Locations include Oosterkade 31 Stadskanaal, Phoenixweg 2 Veendam and Drenthweg 3 Ter Apel.
Latest 2025 audited report supersedes undated website wording of 1,300; headcount here is a documented employee subgroup and therefore a conservative employer minimum.

employers.name: Nedmag

size.employees_text: Official organisation and careers pages describe approximately 150 employees across its locations near Veendam.

notes: General internship enquiries are welcomed, but no HR-specific programme or vacancy was verified in this employer-only research.

employers.name: Mobacc Group
notes: Current official vacancy confirms Veendam offices/factory and Mobacc/Pharmaspray relationship. Recruiter Nomilk2day reports circa 250 employees, but no first-party headcount was verified; keep size unknown. Recruiter URL: https://nomilk2day.nl/bedrijven/mobacc-group

employers.name: Gemeente Pekela

size.employees_text: Employer-owned public organisation profile states the 51–200 employee band.

notes: Official budget 2025 separately reports occupied FTE per 1,000 residents, but an exact payroll total was not derived. LinkedIn band is employer-reported, not an audited headcount.

employers.name: Gemeente Westerwolde
notes: Third-party organisation profiles repeat 250+ colleagues, but the official page only calls this a small organisation; keep size unknown until employer staffing evidence is checked. Official vacancy page links Werken voor Groningen.

rejected.name: QSIL Nederland Winschoten
rejected.reason: Factory closed in August 2024 and dismantled in 2025; historic 122 employees must not count as a current employer.
